name: How long should a general contractor project take?

mainEntity.name: How long should a general contractor project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timelines vary by scope, permitting, material availability, inspections, and weather, so there is no single standard duration. The important question is whether the contractor can give you a realistic start date, milestone schedule, and a clear process for handling delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: It depends on the project size and delays, but you should get a milestone schedule and a realistic completion estimate.
